family.description: This entry represents a family of phage proteins that adopt a small beta barrel-like domain. The family is found in phages infecting members of the Enterobacteriaceae, such as Escherichia, Salmonella, Klebsiella, Cronobacter, Citrobacter, Erwinia, and Pectobacterium. The exact function of this protein within the phage tail is unknown. The family shows a highly conserved length of around 60-75 amino acids, with a few members having N- or C-terminal extensions.
family.name: Domain of unknown function (DUF7205)
